policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V SBIR portfolio shows ongoing reentry manufacturing work
items.summary: V appears in SBIR portfolio listings for hypersonic/reentry capsule and on-orbit manufacturing-related development work, evidencing continued R&D and test/integration milestones.

items.headline: NASA Space Act Agreement: conformance tech transfer
items.summary: NASA’s funded Space Act Agreement PDF documents V’s partnership for Conformal Pica (C-Pica) tech transfer and commercial production, supporting government-backed program activity.

items.headline: US AI labs trust/safety debate intensifies
items.summary: Axios reports lawmakers and officials are pushing for AI safety oversight while discussions continue around how labs (including O) should comply. Potential near-term regulatory pressure remains a key risk factor.

items.headline: GPT-6 Astra: next-gen for work
items.summary: O introduced GPT-6 Astra, highlighting improvements across coding, research, computer use, and complex multi-step tasks. Limited org access is rolling out before broader availability.

items.headline: Paul Christiano joins O Foundation council
items.summary: O posted that Paul Christiano will join the O Foundation council, adding additional senior safety research leadership to governance/oversight.
